units.source_text: 被你抛弃的、理解白莲花心的我，是不是正像这句话那样呢？

en.t: I, who have been abandoned by you and who understand the heart of the white lotus, am I not just like those words?

units.source_text: 面对名叫白莲花的美丽的森林女神，风神不知不觉恋慕起她来了。

en.t: Before the beautiful forest goddess named White Lotus, the wind god found himself falling in love with her before he knew it.

units.source_text: 不知怎的，这件事传进了风神的恋人花神的耳朵里。

en.t: Somehow, this matter reached the ears of the flower goddess, the wind god's lover.

units.source_text: 花神忌妒之余，将一无所知的清白的白莲花从宫中驱赶出去。

en.t: In her jealousy, the flower goddess drove the innocent White Lotus, who knew nothing of it, out of the palace.

units.source_text: 白莲花在野地里哭了好几夜，然后她忽然悟到：既然如此，索性变成花算了。

en.t: White Lotus wept in the fields for many nights, and then suddenly understood: if this is how things are, I may as well become a flower.

units.source_text: 只要这个世界存在，我就作为美丽的花活下去。

en.t: As long as this world exists, I will live on as a beautiful flower.

units.source_text: 以花那颗纯洁的心，去承受天地的恩赐。

en.t: With the pure heart of a flower, I will receive the blessings of heaven and earth.
